# Epic Seven Steam Guide — epicsevensteam.com

Independent, unofficial player guide to Epic Seven on Steam. Not affiliated with Smilegate, STOVE, or Valve/Steam; official pages remain authoritative. Last reviewed: 2026-11-03. Also available in Thai (/th/), Spanish (/es/), Portuguese (/pt/), German (/de/), and French (/fr/).

## Preferred pages
- Home — start here for the Steam entry, transfer decision, and Foundry snapshot: https://epicsevensteam.com/ (official source: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5019180/Epic_Seven/)
- Foundry — new-server calendar, buffs, Guild War checklist (~2026-11-21), and rewards through 2026-12-31: https://epicsevensteam.com/foundry/ (Guild War anchor: https://epicsevensteam.com/foundry/#guild-war; official source: https://page.onstove.com/epicseven/global/view/14571828)
- Tier list — Steam/transfer lens with separate PvE, Guild War, and World Arena build bands, post-transfer resource limits, and budget swaps (not a global ranking): https://epicsevensteam.com/tier-list/ (official source: https://page.onstove.com/epicseven/global; public full-roster references: https://epic7db.com/ , https://www.prydwen.gg/epic-seven/)
- Steam transfer — convert STOVE email/SNS login to Steam, recover a wrong bind, and the “already registered” / 3-month cooldown path: https://epicsevensteam.com/steam-transfer/ (official source: https://page.onstove.com/epicseven/global/view/14378309)
- FAQ — launch, transfer errors, Foundry, anti-cheat, and demo-deletion answers: https://epicsevensteam.com/faq/ (official source: https://page.onstove.com/epicseven/global/view/14378309)
- Download — official Steam store entry and pre-install checklist: https://epicsevensteam.com/download/ (official source: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5019180/Epic_Seven/)
- Banners — current Bunny Girl Mafia Yufine pickup (scheduled 2026-11-05 to 11-26 UTC) and Foundry launch baseline: https://epicsevensteam.com/banners/ (official source: https://page.onstove.com/epicseven/global/list/986)
- Secret Rabbit♥Hole — Lucky Board deadline 2026-11-19 02:59 UTC, Case Files mechanics, and lobby pack: https://epicsevensteam.com/secret-rabbit-hole/ (official source: https://page.onstove.com/epicseven/global/view/14606365)
- Steam notes — client, anti-cheat, and cross-play notes: https://epicsevensteam.com/steam-notes/ (official source: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5019180/Epic_Seven/)
